heads.description: CRDT-capable, security-first, multi-format and multi-version messaging language. One message language with interchangeable encodings (JSON type-encoding <-> equivalent binary <-> optionally YAML / structured-markdown / Gleam type-notation for nested structure); a routing + capability header segment carrying amulets + macaroons; QUIC-optimized binary transmission; forward/backward version tolerance (a legacy processor skips unknown elements, a newer processor gracefully ignores or repair-routes older content). Security by design from the ground up: amulets, macaroon signatures, multiple signatures over whole-content AND sub-content, transparent transport of formatting payloads. CRDT-first: collision-free replicated data types as the substrate for CRDT-capable services, message stores, content stores, and large documents (structured collections of CRDT documents). MVP-first; uses the three-role-agent-team pattern (plan/generate/evaluate + curate) for its prior-art, web-research and synthesis pipelines.
